verdict.rationale: Bento documents its own Data Deletion Requests API, which queues anonymization of a subscriber by email for a specific site. That gives programmatic, per-person deletion control, but nothing in the evidence covers retention settings or account-wide data purge. Missing for 10: configurable data retention periods/policies, full (non-anonymization) deletion or account-level data purge, deletion exposed via MCP/CLI, independent corroboration.
